items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: I played with Buddy Petit and I played with Chris Kelly for a while.

ctx.x: He never knew. Well he's one of the old drummers around here. He died long years ago. Well we played on with Jack until finally we started learning a little more about the music again and started getting off again, you know. At that time, I mean the older musicians was always trying to take advantage of the young musicians. They never wanted to treat them fat, you see. So then I got a chance then to switch and play with different bands. I played with Buddy Petit and I played with Chris Kelly for a while. And we…
Was that on clarinet or sax or what?
